ios_1786000653.author: Your boy, blue
ios_1786000653.text:
Hi! I just wanted to say that it is greatly inconvenient to have no access to co-workers via in app-scheduling, which is something my previous app allowed me to do. This is causing an abrupt left turn, in terms of fluidity. I think that it's important to have open communications that allow me to interact with individuals whom I actively see and conduct daily business with on a regular basis, this includes;
•Ability to see what days I'm working and who I'm working with. 
•Ability to swap and pickup shifts with and from other employees.
These issues are really basic, but can still be really easily over looked! However, If things like this are left unaddressed, then they'll never continue to as is a simplicities error, which is annoying at most, resolves then to fester . Just my two cents, thank you for your time. :)
ios_1786000653.title: Read me!!

ios_1797671601.author: NikkiD1016
ios_1797671601.text: I normally don't write reviews but this app is beyond frustrating. This app could probably have great potential but it is lacking in so many areas. You can't see anyone's schedules but your own. There's no way to get shifts covered or swap unless you text/call everyone and bother them. And that's if you have all your coworkers info in the first place. And when messages are sent out through the app they aren't reaching everyone. There's no way to show double shifts or when you're on a double shift with two different job codes. It hasn't even been a week and I miss HotSchedules.
ios_1797671601.title: More like NotSchedules

ios_1921447594.author: Ayemannn
ios_1921447594.text:
There is nothing good to say about this app so far other than it needs a ton of work, and from being a previous user of HotSchedules for 7 years, having to switch to this really blows. Here are some requests and suggestions for the developers from an employees standpoint:
1. This app is not user friendly- you cannot release or pickup shifts 
2. We have no way to see our other coworkers schedule! This by far is highly frustrating and inconvenient. How am I suppose to know wether or not I am the only one scheduled that day/night or who comes in before or after me. Knowing this is very important so employees can plan accordingly.
3. We cannot message others directly through this application, and since we don't know who is or isn't working we virtually have no way to reach other employees for a quick shift cover if needed.
Thanks! Hope this review helps and this application receives the improvements it's needed QUICKLY.
ios_1921447594.title: Needs A TON of work

ios_2324307790.author: genbolanos
ios_2324307790.text:
This is honestly the worst app for work and needs some serious improvements ! I’ve had 7shifts and HotSchedules which are awesome and better than this.
What needs improving ?
1. Notifications: this apps doesn’t notify when our schedules are out or when someone is giving away their shift. 
2. Contacts: for some reason, the contacts went away ??? Now we can’t see people’s contact information, which is needed when we need to get ahold of them. 
3. Messaging: we wouldn’t need contacts info if we could directly message in the app! Or even have a place where we could post messages like 7shifts! 
4. Work schedule: being able to see who is or isn’t working for the day would be helpful. That way we’re not wasting our time messaging people who are already working. 
5. Time off request: apparently at work we have to write down our time off request in a notebook because this app doesn’t let us request time off!! It disappears from the system once approved ??
Please ! Improve the app and make it useful to those who use it. There are so many changes that are needed. If I had the power to change what app we use I would.
ios_2324307790.title: Please improve

ios_9323910759.author: Calivin858
ios_9323910759.text: When I was introduced to this program I was very excited as the videos seemed to depict an easier and updated system to monitor the work place. As time went on I noticed that there is key features missing for example integration with floor plan, table orders with details even if open at the time, server sales and performance (a average sales per guest, Average sale on tables, voids, comps and promos along with details to who they pertain to) though the website does contain these,Its difficult to manage a location and having to constantly look at multiple apps (that don’t contain everything) or needing to be sitting in front of a computer to get all the information.  The new “update” now does not show labor percentage. so the example picture on this app info no longer is true. Labor is definitely one of the most important features in order to maximize net sales (surprisingly many locations agree). I’m now starting to miss the ancient PULSE app that had everything in one app. I would definitely give up the updated platform and go with an outdated platform that will give you everything in one app and more details on their desktop program. The suggested scheduling or ordering takes over a month to get into rhythm so it will creat a cost PNL. Please fix these these or add these features. I knwit the company I work for trialed this program for close to a year and still seems to be missing things. This program might be intended for work places but maybe not the service industry. Sorry to write this but hopefully you improve this program to the actual  potential it can be.
